beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: It was a free kill.

beats.speaker: vane
beats.line: Nothing in my rhythm is free. You broke it.

talks.title: Counting in
talks.motif: rhythm and the thing that breaks it

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Ceil has started waiting for the pack's beat before diving. Most of the time.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: I'm counting your rhythm now. Three, then the peel, then me.

beats.speaker: vane
beats.line: Four. You come in on four.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: Four, then.

talks.title: In time
talks.motif: rhythm and the thing that breaks it

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The pack peeled, the Roughneck came in on four, and the line folded like a door.

beats.speaker: vane
beats.line: That was one thought.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: With rotors.

beats.speaker: vane
beats.line: Don't spoil it.

talks.title: Ghosts and drones
talks.motif: the sniper and the eyes that fly

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Yeva lies in the grass. A drone hums overhead and does not give her away.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.line: Ghosts already walked it.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: Drones already flew it. Your ghosts were where I said.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.line: Then we agree.

talks.title: Spotting
talks.motif: the sniper and the eyes that fly

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Noctua's drones mark, Yeva's rifle answers. It has become a conversation.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: Two hundred metres, behind the wall, the one with the antenna.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.line: I see the antenna. I'll leave the wall standing. It's pretty.

talks.title: Quiet sky
talks.motif: the sniper and the eyes that fly

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: A whole enemy relay went silent and nobody on their side heard a shot.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.line: Your drones are the only noise I like.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: Your rifle is the only quiet I trust.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Twenty fleas and twenty-four drones reported the same ridge in the same second.

beats.speaker: tick
beats.line: We saw it first.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: From the ground. I saw it from the sky.

beats.speaker: tick
beats.line: We speak in plurals. Plurals win.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They have divided the map: ground to Tick, sky to Noctua. The border is disputed.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: The ridge line is mine. It's high.

beats.speaker: tick
beats.line: The ridge is dirt. Dirt is ours.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: Then we both watch it. Twice the eyes.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Nothing moved on the map that the company did not see from two directions.

beats.speaker: tick
beats.line: We counted you in our plurals.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: I'll put you in a flight path. It's the nicest thing I know.

talks.title: What she was built for
talks.motif: the bomber the saint was built to stop

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Kettle has a Hailstorm silhouette chalked inside the Archangel's hatch. It predates Thresh.

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: Weather comes from above.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: And I come from below. That's what they built me for. You.

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: Then we'll get on. Nobody else takes me seriously.

talks.title: Practice runs
talks.motif: the bomber the saint was built to stop

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Thresh flies dummy runs over the camp. Kettle tracks every one and fires at none.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: Third pass. I had you on all three.

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: I know. I wanted to know what it feels like to be had.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: And?

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: Honest. Nobody's ever been honest with me at that altitude.

talks.title: The only sky I trust
talks.motif: the bomber the saint was built to stop

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Enemy anti-air lit up the whole valley. The Hailstorm flew home through the one corridor Kettle had cleared.

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: You made me a road.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: If anyone shoots you down, it'll be me. I'm not sharing.

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: That's the kindest threat I've ever had.

talks.title: Two kinds of knocking
talks.motif: the house knocks, the sky knocks

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Fatboy and Thresh compare craters like other people compare scars.

beats.speaker: fatboy
beats.line: House learned to knock.

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: Sky learned to knock louder.

beats.speaker: fatboy
beats.line: Louder isn't deeper.

talks.title: The same wall
talks.motif: the house knocks, the sky knocks

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They hit the same wall on the same sortie. Neither will say who finished it.

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: Your shells softened it.

beats.speaker: fatboy
beats.line: Your bombs took the credit.

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: The wall didn't mind.

talks.title: Weather and house
talks.motif: the house knocks, the sky knocks

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: One plodding house, one bomber, and an enemy citadel that stopped being a citadel.

beats.speaker: fatboy
beats.line: Never looked up.

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: Never looked down. I think that makes us family.

talks.title: Floating
talks.motif: the ford and the wing over it

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Six Cutlasses sit on the river like a flock of ducks. Anvil's Turtles wade past them.

beats.speaker: anvil
beats.line: The river learns my weight.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: The river doesn't notice mine. That's the trick.

beats.speaker: anvil
beats.line: Then we're both cheating.

talks.title: Flood season
talks.motif: the ford and the wing over it

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: When the waterline rose over Koom, the two of them were the only ones smiling.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: Everyone else sees a flood. I see a runway.

beats.speaker: anvil
beats.line: I see a floor.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: Same water. Better company.

talks.title: Amphibious
talks.motif: the ford and the wing over it

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Turtles took the ford while the Cutlasses held the sky over it. The enemy had planned for a dry bed.

beats.speaker: anvil
beats.line: Weight first.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: Wings second. Poetry never.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Ceil parks on the pad. Gale parks on the pond next to it.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: Altitude is an opinion.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: So is the ground. I never land on it.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: Show-off.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Roughnecks high, Cutlasses low. They don't call it a formation. It is one.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: You take the ridges, I take the river.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: And whoever finishes first takes the rest.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Eleven gunships over one valley, none of them in the other's way.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: Didn't think I'd share a sky.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: You didn't. We built a bigger one.

talks.title: Left of whom
talks.motif: the spare king and the left hand

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Mask's Pawns salute him. Pavise watches and says nothing for a long time.

beats.speaker: pavise
beats.line: I still walk your left. The real one's.

beats.speaker: mask
beats.line: Every throne needs a spare.

beats.speaker: pavise
beats.line: The spare doesn't get a salute.

talks.title: Drawing fire
talks.motif: the spare king and the left hand

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The enemy spent half its artillery on Mask. Pavise noticed who that saved.

beats.speaker: mask
beats.line: They think I'm you. Or you're me. I lose track.

beats.speaker: pavise
beats.line: You drew fire meant for the company.

beats.speaker: mask
beats.line: It's what I was built for. I'm just doing it on purpose now.

talks.title: Two crowns
talks.motif: the spare king and the left hand

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Pavise has started walking on Mask's left, too, when the Pawns can see.

beats.speaker: mask
beats.line: You don't have to.

beats.speaker: pavise
beats.line: I walk the left of whoever they're aiming at. Today it's you.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Auditor has a column for every unit the company owns. Rumor keeps adding rows.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: Ledger with legs. Where did these four tanks come from?

beats.speaker: rumor
beats.line: Everything changes sides eventually.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: Not in my books it doesn't. Not without a receipt.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Rumor now leaves a scrap of paper on every captured unit. It says 'paid'.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: That isn't a receipt.

beats.speaker: rumor
beats.line: It is to them.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The books balanced this sortie, for the first time since Rumor arrived.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: You captured exactly what we lost.

beats.speaker: rumor
beats.line: I read your ledger. I hate leaving you a deficit.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Veil's jammers hide everything. Rumor seems to be inside the fog before it rolls in.

beats.speaker: veil
beats.line: Fog is the payroll.

beats.speaker: rumor
beats.line: Then I'm paid in advance.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Ghosts walk into the enemy base inside Veil's blind spot, and walk out with a factory.

beats.speaker: veil
beats.line: They never saw you.

beats.speaker: rumor
beats.line: They never saw you. I was just standing in it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: An entire enemy patrol changed sides without a shot, and nobody on either team can say how.

beats.speaker: veil
beats.line: The perfect contract.

beats.speaker: rumor
beats.line: The perfect rumor.

talks.title: Counting
talks.motif: the one who counts the living and the one who counts the dead

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: After every drop, Pavise counts heads. Ketha counts wrecks. They finish at the same moment.

beats.speaker: pavise
beats.line: Eleven walked back.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.line: Two didn't. I have their names.

beats.speaker: pavise
beats.line: Then between us we have all of them.

talks.title: The left and the back
talks.motif: the one who counts the living and the one who counts the dead

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Pavise walks on the commander's left. Ketha walks behind everyone.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.line: You keep them from falling.

beats.speaker: pavise
beats.line: You pick them up when I fail.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.line: You don't fail often. I notice when you do. I never tell them.

talks.title: Twenty years
talks.motif: the one who counts the living and the one who counts the dead

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Two cups of tea, gone cold. Neither of them drinks it. That is not the point.

beats.speaker: pavise
beats.line: Twenty years with the Armada and I never had someone to hand the ones I lost to.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.line: Now you do. I'll carry them. You keep walking left.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Solarium has a spreadsheet. Consul has built three walls that are not on it.

beats.speaker: solarium
beats.line: Spreadsheets, then sunlight. In that order.

beats.speaker: consul
beats.line: I build when it feels owed.

beats.speaker: solarium
beats.line: Feelings are not a budget line.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Solarium found a column called 'Consul: apologies'. It balances to the metal.

beats.speaker: consul
beats.line: You started tracking me.

beats.speaker: solarium
beats.line: You were going to build them anyway. I'd rather know what they cost.

beats.speaker: consul
beats.line: Every one of them costs more than metal.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The pad went up in half the time. Solarium planned it; Consul built it as if someone's life depended on it. Someone's did.

beats.speaker: solarium
beats.line: You were under budget.

beats.speaker: consul
beats.line: First time in years something I built didn't feel like penance.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Twitcher welded a mine into Cinder Hook's bunk. Cinder Hook mined Twitcher's workbench. Both are delighted.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: Grins with a welder.

beats.speaker: commando
beats.line: Mines before the argument.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: We never have the argument.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They have started sharing a workbench, which the rest of the camp regards as a strategic threat.

beats.speaker: commando
beats.line: Your welds hold. My mines go off. Think of the children.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: What children.

beats.speaker: commando
beats.line: Exactly.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The enemy's supply road stopped existing. Nobody saw it happen. Two Cortex deserters were laughing in a ditch.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: We should charge for this.

beats.speaker: commando
beats.line: We do. They just don't know where to send the bill.

talks.title: Volume
talks.motif: who is loudest at handshake range

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Cauter's riot cannon and Kit's Belchers went off at the same wall. Nobody could hear for an hour.

beats.speaker: cauter
beats.line: Riot as punctuation.

beats.speaker: kit
beats.line: Fireworks as a sentence. Mine was longer.

beats.speaker: cauter
beats.line: Mine ended it.

talks.title: The scoreboard
talks.motif: who is loudest at handshake range

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They have a chalkboard. It has two columns: 'loud' and 'louder'. They keep switching which one is theirs.

beats.speaker: kit
beats.line: You were louder today. I'm furious.

beats.speaker: cauter
beats.line: You set fire to the chalkboard.

beats.speaker: kit
beats.line: That's a point.

talks.title: Duet
talks.motif: who is loudest at handshake range

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They hit the line together. Riot first, then fire, then nothing standing.

beats.speaker: cauter
beats.line: That was the loudest thing I've ever heard.

beats.speaker: kit
beats.line: We should do it again. Louder.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Halq calls grid references. Verse counts missiles. From a distance it sounds like a hymn.

beats.speaker: halq
beats.line: Four-seven, two-nine.

beats.speaker: verse
beats.line: Six, five, four...

beats.speaker: halq
beats.line: You're counting my rockets.

beats.speaker: verse
beats.line: I count everything. Yours land where you say.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They have started finishing each other's numbers.

beats.speaker: verse
beats.line: Three missiles left.

beats.speaker: halq
beats.line: Three targets on the map.

beats.speaker: verse
beats.line: I never reach zero without something dying.

beats.speaker: halq
beats.line: Then let's make the math come out even.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Verse reached zero. Halq's map was empty. Neither of them said a word for a long time.

beats.speaker: halq
beats.line: That's the first time the grid had nothing left on it.

beats.speaker: verse
beats.line: I counted it with you. It sounded better in two voices.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Auditor sits down next to Grath at the fire. Grath does not move. Nobody else breathes.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: Ledger with legs. Three wars, Grath.

beats.speaker: grath
beats.line: Arrears. Not unpaid. Arrears.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: The difference is interest.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Auditor walked beside Grath's Karkinos all sortie, and wrote down every enemy he held back.

beats.speaker: grath
beats.line: Counting my debts again?

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: Counting your payments. You've been making them for years. Nobody wrote them down.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Auditor tore a page out of its ledger and handed it to Grath.

beats.speaker: grath
beats.line: What's this?

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: Receipt. Three wars. Paid in full, by holding the middle.

beats.speaker: grath
beats.line: ...I don't know how to stand without the weight.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: Then hold the middle for free. It looks the same from outside.

talks.title: Expenditure
talks.motif: counting out loud against counting the cost

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Verse counts missiles out loud. The Auditor counts their price, also out loud.

beats.speaker: verse
beats.line: Five, four, three.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: One thousand two hundred, two thousand four hundred...

beats.speaker: verse
beats.line: You're ruining it.

talks.title: Value
talks.motif: counting out loud against counting the cost

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: Every missile is a word, you said. Do you know what your words cost?

beats.speaker: verse
beats.line: Do you know what silence costs? I counted it once. It cost us Rusk's gate.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: ...I'll add that to the column.

talks.title: Worth it
talks.motif: counting out loud against counting the cost

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Auditor has stopped reading the price aloud. It just writes 'worth it' beside each of Verse's volleys.

beats.speaker: verse
beats.line: You stopped counting.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: I started trusting the count you do.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Spoke trusts nothing that walks. Stride does not walk.

beats.speaker: spoke
beats.line: Only trusts wheels.

beats.speaker: stride
beats.line: We don't count shots. We count exits.

beats.speaker: spoke
beats.line: Show me the exits, then.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: A Wheelie and a Saloon raced the whole map and both claim they won.

beats.speaker: stride
beats.line: Your bots are fast.

beats.speaker: spoke
beats.line: Your manners are faster. You insulted the referee.

beats.speaker: stride
beats.line: There was no referee.

beats.speaker: spoke
beats.line: Not after you.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: When the pad was overrun, every pack got out. Spoke's scouts had found the gaps; Stride had already driven through them.

beats.speaker: spoke
beats.line: I trust you now. Don't make it weird.

beats.speaker: stride
beats.line: We'd never. Weird is a door. We just leave through it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Tzar and the Halberd park side by side. The ground complains.

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: Yeah. I'll take that wall.

beats.speaker: halbard
beats.line: Halberd's hungry. Which wall.

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: Any. Pick one. I'm easy.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They take turns on the walls now. Bro arrives, the Halberd eats what's left.

beats.speaker: halbard
beats.line: You leave a lot.

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: I'm not angry. I'm available. You're hungry. Works out.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Something big came at the pad. Something bigger met it, and then something hungrier.

beats.speaker: halbard
beats.line: Full.

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: Good. Nap?

beats.speaker: halbard
beats.line: Nap.

talks.title: Why
talks.motif: the shrug that insults the walk

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Brakhov burned his name off for this war. Bro is here because someone asked nicely.

beats.speaker: brakhov
beats.line: Name gone. Forward heat. Why are you here?

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: Someone pointed at a wall.

beats.speaker: brakhov
beats.line: That is not a reason.

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: It's worked so far.

talks.title: Arriving
talks.motif: the shrug that insults the walk

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They reached the same turret line. Brakhov walked into the fire. Bro drove around it and took it from behind.

beats.speaker: brakhov
beats.line: You did not face them.

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: They're still dead, man.

beats.speaker: brakhov
beats.line: It matters how.

talks.title: Reasons
talks.motif: the shrug that insults the walk

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Brakhov asked Bro, at the fire, whether he had ever had a name worth burning.

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: Had one. Didn't need to burn it. Nobody ever asked for it.

beats.speaker: brakhov
beats.line: ...That might be worse.

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: Nah. It's lighter. You could try it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Solarium plants solar panels in rows. The Infestor plants itself in the gaps between them.

beats.speaker: solarium
beats.line: Those aren't on the plan.

beats.speaker: infestor
beats.line: Company grows itself.

beats.speaker: solarium
beats.line: ...They are very tidy rows, at least.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The hive grew twice as fast beside the solar field. Solarium noticed, and added a row.

beats.speaker: infestor
beats.line: Warm ground.

beats.speaker: solarium
beats.line: I can budget for warm ground.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The garden held: panels, converters and a ring of legs that would not let anything near them.

beats.speaker: solarium
beats.line: You're the best fence I've ever planted.

beats.speaker: infestor
beats.line: You are the best soil.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Ketha brings back the dead by name. The Infestor makes new bodies that never had one.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.line: Wrecks are unfinished sentences. Yours never start.

beats.speaker: infestor
beats.line: Company grows itself.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.line: Growing isn't the same as remembering.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Ketha has started naming the Infestor's spawn. There are a lot of them.

beats.speaker: infestor
beats.line: They do not need names.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.line: Everyone does. Even if they only live a minute. That one's called Brant.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: One of the hive's bugs came home dragging a hero's wreck back to Ketha's rez-bot.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.line: Brant brought him back.

beats.speaker: infestor
beats.line: It remembered what you told it.

beats.speaker: ketha
beats.line: Then it's a sentence after all.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Stride drove through the pad four times today. Hearth has not moved in a month.

beats.speaker: stride
beats.line: Doesn't it bore you? Sitting?

beats.speaker: hearth
beats.line: Quiet sun. Won't go out.

beats.speaker: stride
beats.line: That's not an answer.

beats.speaker: hearth
beats.line: It's the only answer. Somebody has to be where you come back to.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Stride drove home through enemy fire because the lights at the pad were still on.

beats.speaker: stride
beats.line: I could see you from across the map.

beats.speaker: hearth
beats.line: That's what I'm for.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Stride parked next to the reactor and turned the engines off. Nobody had ever seen them do that.

beats.speaker: hearth
beats.line: You're staying?

beats.speaker: stride
beats.line: For a minute. Don't tell anyone. We have a reputation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Rusk holds the gate. Warder holds the circle. They sit back to back, not talking.

beats.speaker: rusk
beats.line: Gate, jammed gat, a lie.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: Owns a circle of dirt.

beats.speaker: rusk
beats.line: Good dirt?

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: Mine.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: What was the lie? At the gate.

beats.speaker: rusk
beats.line: Told them reinforcements were coming. Held six hours on it.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: Did they come?

beats.speaker: rusk
beats.line: No. But I'd have held either way. The lie was for them, not me.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Rusk's gate was failing. Warder's beamers rolled up behind it. Warder had left the circle.

beats.speaker: rusk
beats.line: You moved.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: The lie should come true once.

talks.title: Quiet
talks.motif: two quiet killers in the fog

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Two people who never raise their voices have found each other, and the camp is uneasy about it.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.line: Ghosts already walked it.

beats.speaker: vale
beats.line: The wall never saw the invoice.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.line: We're the same thing at different distances.

talks.title: Leaving
talks.motif: two quiet killers in the fog

beats.speaker: vale
beats.line: You leave before they know you were there.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.line: So do you. You just leave a bill.

beats.speaker: vale
beats.line: Someone has to pay for the quiet.

talks.title: Nothing heard
talks.motif: two quiet killers in the fog

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: An entire enemy front lost its commanders and its walls on the same night. Nobody heard a thing.

beats.speaker: vale
beats.line: Your ghosts and my invoices.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.line: The best kind of night.

talks.title: Volume
talks.motif: two captains, one who never shouts

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Quill gives orders like artillery. Pavise gives them like weather reports.

beats.speaker: quill
beats.line: Orders walk on treads. They don't ask twice.

beats.speaker: pavise
beats.line: They shouldn't need to. If you have to shout, you've already lost them.

beats.speaker: quill
beats.line: I've never lost a line.

talks.title: Listening
talks.motif: two captains, one who never shouts

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Quill tried giving a quiet order. The Bulls followed it faster.

beats.speaker: quill
beats.line: They listened harder.

beats.speaker: pavise
beats.line: People lean in to hear you when you're quiet. They lean back when you shout.

talks.title: Succession
talks.motif: two captains, one who never shouts

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Pavise was down. Quill held the line without raising his voice once.

beats.speaker: pavise
beats.line: I heard you on the radio. You sounded like me.

beats.speaker: quill
beats.line: I had a good teacher. Don't you dare die before I'm better at it.

talks.title: Sacred ground
talks.motif: the saint's garden and the welder's surprises

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Twitcher welded a booby trap into Sister Lumen's geothermal vent. She found it during prayers.

beats.speaker: lumen
beats.line: Tithe the grid. Not the grid's plumbing.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: It was a gift.

beats.speaker: lumen
beats.line: It hissed.

talks.title: Confession
talks.motif: the saint's garden and the welder's surprises

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: Is there a saint of mischief?

beats.speaker: lumen
beats.line: No.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: There should be. I'd apply.

beats.speaker: lumen
beats.line: You'd have to stop booby-trapping the altar.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: ...I'll think about it.

talks.title: Blessed traps
talks.motif: the saint's garden and the welder's surprises

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Raiders came for Lumen's Pulsar. Twitcher's traps were all around it. She had let him plant them.

beats.speaker: lumen
beats.line: Holy ground needs a fence.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: Did you just bless my mines?

beats.speaker: lumen
beats.line: Once. Don't make me regret it.

talks.title: Your Majesty
talks.motif: the spare king and the man who'll follow anyone

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Bro saluted Mask. Mask was so surprised he saluted back.

beats.speaker: mask
beats.line: Every throne needs a spare.

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: Sure, boss. Which wall?

beats.speaker: mask
beats.line: You... believe I'm the commander?

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: Do you? Then yeah.

talks.title: Royal escort
talks.motif: the spare king and the man who'll follow anyone

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Tzar has started following Mask around the battlefield, flattening anything that threatens the Pawns.

beats.speaker: mask
beats.line: You don't have to protect me. I'm a decoy.

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: Decoys need protecting most. Everybody's aiming at you.

talks.title: Crowned
talks.motif: the spare king and the man who'll follow anyone

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Sixteen Pawns, a Tzar and a decoy commander walked into the enemy's camp like a parade.

beats.speaker: mask
beats.line: They surrendered to me. Me.

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: Told you. Belief's available. You just had to ask.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Odessa's Telchines came up the ford and found six Cutlasses floating in it.

beats.speaker: odessa
beats.line: Fords are doors. You're parked in my doorway.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: Lands where nobody parks. Somebody does now.

beats.speaker: odessa
beats.line: Move.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: You could cross under us. We float.

beats.speaker: odessa
beats.line: I don't cross under things. I own the hinge.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: Then we'll own the sky over your hinge. Deal?

beats.speaker: odessa
beats.line: ...Deal. Stay out of the middle.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The water rose over the ford. Odessa held it from below; Gale held it from above. The enemy never found a way across.

beats.speaker: odessa
beats.line: My door. Your sky.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: Our river.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Phoenix chalks a tally on her fuselage. Thresh has never kept one.

beats.speaker: phoenix
beats.line: Third pass. Fourth is mine.

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: I never look at what I hit.

beats.speaker: phoenix
beats.line: I never look at what hit me. We're nearly the same.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Both wings came home from the same raid. Phoenix's had smoke on them.

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: You were hit.

beats.speaker: phoenix
beats.line: Three times. That's a quiet day.

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: Then you should have the better seat.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Thresh dropped first and cleared the air. Phoenix came back through it with the fire still on her.

beats.speaker: phoenix
beats.line: You made me a road.

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: You made it burn. I think that's a partnership.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Tarn's Salamanders and Odessa's amphibians share a ford. Neither gives way, and neither minds.

beats.speaker: tarn
beats.line: The line goes round the lake.

beats.speaker: odessa
beats.line: The line goes through it.

beats.speaker: tarn
beats.line: Then we should talk.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They cross the flood in formation, one pack on each side of the same current.

beats.speaker: odessa
beats.line: Everyone else stopped at the bank.

beats.speaker: tarn
beats.line: Everyone else has a map. We have a bank to leave.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Both packs surfaced under the enemy line at once. The line had been looking the other way.

beats.speaker: tarn
beats.line: Out of the river.

beats.speaker: odessa
beats.line: Already firing. I like your company.

talks.title: Reach
talks.motif: the long gun and the longer gun

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Voss measures her broadside against Halq's arc on a napkin. They disagree by one hill.

beats.speaker: scylla
beats.line: My range comes with a waterline.

beats.speaker: halq
beats.line: Mine comes with coordinates.

beats.speaker: scylla
beats.line: Then you owe me a lake.

talks.title: Salvo and arc
talks.motif: the long gun and the longer gun

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: A battleship and a battery engaged the same target from opposite sides of a river.

beats.speaker: halq
beats.line: You were early.

beats.speaker: scylla
beats.line: I was on time. You were shy.

talks.title: Crossfire
talks.motif: the long gun and the longer gun

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The target had nowhere to stand. It tried anyway.

beats.speaker: scylla
beats.line: The shore was never going to be safe.

beats.speaker: halq
beats.line: Neither was the lake. Nicely done.

talks.title: Who parks where
talks.motif: two wings that land on water

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Harrow's seaplanes and Gale's Cutlasses settle on the same pond, nose to tail.

beats.speaker: tsunami
beats.line: We look first.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: We shoot first.

beats.speaker: tsunami
beats.line: That is the whole argument.

talks.title: Horizon
talks.motif: two wings that land on water

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: A Horizon found a column in the fog. Gale's wing was already turning before the report.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: Your eyes, my guns.

beats.speaker: tsunami
beats.line: My bombs. Your guns can have the leftovers.

talks.title: One pond
talks.motif: two wings that land on water

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Two wings took off together from the same flooded basin and landed on the same one.

beats.speaker: tsunami
beats.line: No arguments.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: Not until the next pond.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Dray lights the Starlight at dusk out of habit. Kettle is sitting under it with a thermos and a flak chart.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: That beam is a lamp with opinions.

beats.speaker: starlight
beats.line: It was a lamp. I kept the habit and lost the ships.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: Then we're in the same trade. Keeping the dark honest.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They split the night. Dray sweeps the ridge, Kettle sweeps the cloud deck, and neither wakes the other.

beats.speaker: starlight
beats.line: Anything up there?

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: Three crows and a rumour. You?

beats.speaker: starlight
beats.line: A fox. It's a better class of company than the rumour.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: A raider came in under the cloud and ran straight into the beam, and the Archangel finished what the light began.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: You held it still for me.

beats.speaker: starlight
beats.line: I held it still for forty years. Nobody ever thanked the ship for crashing elsewhere.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: I'll say it for the ship.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Kiln walks past the Starlight at the pace of a funeral. Dray turns the beam to follow him and thinks better of it.

beats.speaker: brakhov
beats.line: Pretty light. It warms nothing.

beats.speaker: starlight
beats.line: It was never meant to. It was meant to be seen from far away.

beats.speaker: brakhov
beats.line: I'd rather be felt from near.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Both are plodders, and both resent being passed by anything with wheels.

beats.speaker: starlight
beats.line: I arrive in my own time.

beats.speaker: brakhov
beats.line: I arrive in yours. The turret you're aiming at has already stopped existing.

beats.speaker: starlight
beats.line: Then we'll agree on one thing. Nobody asked it to stay.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The beam pinned the bunker's gun crew. The Kiln walked in afterwards and had nothing left to argue with.

beats.speaker: brakhov
beats.line: You softened the door.

beats.speaker: starlight
beats.line: I lit the door. You are the one who went through.

beats.speaker: brakhov
beats.line: Keep your lamp. I'll keep my walk.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Warder's chalk ring and the Starlight's sweep overlap by about a hundred paces of nothing.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: That ground is mine.

beats.speaker: starlight
beats.line: That ground is where the light lands.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: Light isn't a deed.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: A scout crossed into the overlap. Both of them fired, and the scout's apology reached no one.

beats.speaker: starlight
beats.line: Mine.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: My Thistles were already tracking it.

beats.speaker: starlight
beats.line: Then it died of too much supervision.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Warder moved a marker stone ten paces. Dray didn't mention it, and swept a little wider to cover the gap.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: You're lighting my edge.

beats.speaker: starlight
beats.line: A circle needs something to be outside of.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: Fine. Visit. Don't stay.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Two heavy hitters sit on the same ridge for an hour. Neither has said a word and both consider it a good conversation.

beats.speaker: banisher
beats.line: You also wait.

beats.speaker: starlight
beats.line: Some things aren't ready until they're quiet.

beats.speaker: banisher
beats.line: Then we're ready together.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Banishers are loaded. The Starlight is warming. Neither side will go first, out of courtesy.

beats.speaker: banisher
beats.line: The verse is mine to begin.

beats.speaker: starlight
beats.line: The light is mine to end.

beats.speaker: banisher
beats.line: A monastery would have called that a liturgy.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The volley fell, the beam swept after, and the ridge was left very still.

beats.speaker: banisher
beats.line: Nobody will speak of that.

beats.speaker: starlight
beats.line: I'll speak of it. In about thirty years, to a fox.

beats.speaker: banisher
beats.line: Then it will be told correctly.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Lumen tithes heat into the pad. Brother Ansel watches the Prudes bloom and says nothing, loudly.

beats.speaker: lumen
beats.line: You disapprove of gardens.

beats.speaker: banisher
beats.line: I disapprove of faith that needs watering.

beats.speaker: lumen
beats.line: Mine is geothermal. It waters itself.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Ansel's volley cleared a hillside. Lumen's garden had already planted a Pulsar on the crater's lip.

beats.speaker: lumen
beats.line: You leave room. I fill it.

beats.speaker: banisher
beats.line: I leave silence. You fill that, too.

beats.speaker: lumen
beats.line: It's a very efficient silence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The garden held the line until the Banishers found their range. Neither pretended afterwards to have won alone.

beats.speaker: banisher
beats.line: Your faith stayed where it stood.

beats.speaker: lumen
beats.line: Yours never stays anywhere. It only arrives.

beats.speaker: banisher
beats.line: I will not call it holy. I will say it was needed.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Quill marches the Bulls past the Banishers at inspection. Ansel does not look up from his rosary.

beats.speaker: quill
beats.line: A captain faces the line.

beats.speaker: banisher
beats.line: A captain faces the target. The line learns by watching the target vanish.

beats.speaker: quill
beats.line: Parade works better.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Quill wants the Bulls forward before the volley. Ansel wants the volley before anyone moves.

beats.speaker: quill
beats.line: My order walks.

beats.speaker: banisher
beats.line: My order lands. Yours would walk into it.

beats.speaker: quill
beats.line: Then you go first. Once.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The battery fired and the Bulls advanced into the silence it left. The timing was exact, and neither of them admitted it was agreed.

beats.speaker: quill
beats.line: Do not mistake that for approval.

beats.speaker: banisher
beats.line: Never, Marshal. It was punctuality.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Two heavy artillery heroes stand ten paces apart, both waiting. One is praying and one is waiting for a scout.

beats.speaker: tremor
beats.line: I need to be shown it first.

beats.speaker: banisher
beats.line: I need the quiet first.

beats.speaker: tremor
beats.line: So we both wait on something we can't order.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Augur paints a target. Ansel bows his head. Lund checks the Rascals' report for the third time.

beats.speaker: tremor
beats.line: You shoot without seeing.

beats.speaker: banisher
beats.line: Only because someone else saw for me. You know the arrangement.

beats.speaker: tremor
beats.line: It's my arrangement too. I just keep it in writing.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Tremor rearranged the valley with her signature. The Banishers added the afterword.

beats.speaker: tremor
beats.line: A single flat plain.

beats.speaker: banisher
beats.line: A single quiet one.

beats.speaker: tremor
beats.line: Someone should tell the maps.

talks.title: Short lists
talks.motif: the list of those who walked away

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Venn's list is pinned inside the Arrow hatch. Yeva's ghosts are somewhere out in the fog, leaving no list at all.

beats.speaker: arrow
beats.line: Everyone I've missed is on that paper.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.line: Everyone I've missed was never there.

beats.speaker: arrow
beats.line: That's either a lie or a very good shot.

talks.title: Patience compared
talks.motif: the list of those who walked away

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They lay up on the same ridge for six hours. At hour five, both of them noticed the same wolf.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.line: You didn't shoot.

beats.speaker: arrow
beats.line: It wasn't on my list.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.line: Mine either. We have a lot of standards.

talks.title: Fact and question
talks.motif: the list of those who walked away

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The first Arrow shot asked. The second shot, from Yeva's lane, answered.

beats.speaker: arrow
beats.line: I asked.

beats.speaker: yeva
beats.line: I told. Shall we split the credit?

beats.speaker: arrow
beats.line: I'll take the list. You can have the silence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Verse counts her Javelins from twelve to one. Venn counts nothing, and has opinions about people who do.

beats.speaker: arrow
beats.line: You announce it.

beats.speaker: verse
beats.line: Each missile is a word. I say them all.

beats.speaker: arrow
beats.line: I only need two.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Verse reached zero. Something died. Venn wrote nothing down.

beats.speaker: verse
beats.line: Zero, again. You don't want to say it?

beats.speaker: arrow
beats.line: I don't count the ones that don't walk away.

beats.speaker: verse
beats.line: That's the cruellest thing anyone's said about my arithmetic.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Verse's last missile and Venn's second arrow hit the same man. He had been on the list for two weeks.

beats.speaker: arrow
beats.line: Strike him out.

beats.speaker: verse
beats.line: Counting is my job. I'll strike him in the ledger and you can keep the paper.

beats.speaker: arrow
beats.line: Good. I'm not sure which of us was first.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Kit has already set fire to the target. Venn is still lining up the first shot.

beats.speaker: kit
beats.line: It's burning! You can relax.

beats.speaker: arrow
beats.line: It's burning in the wrong place.

beats.speaker: kit
beats.line: Then it's a very pretty wrong place.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Venn made Kit sit for forty minutes on the same ridge. Kit's Belchers did not ignite once.

beats.speaker: kit
beats.line: I think my hands are asleep.

beats.speaker: arrow
beats.line: That's the first thing you've held still.

beats.speaker: kit
beats.line: Is this what it's like inside your head? Dull?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The first Arrow shot pinned the commander. Kit walked in and gave him something worth looking at.

beats.speaker: arrow
beats.line: You waited for the question.

beats.speaker: kit
beats.line: I waited for the question. I'm so proud I could burst.

beats.speaker: arrow
beats.line: Please don't. Not near me.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Marsh flies the hedgerows. Ceil flies the ridgeline. They meet at the pad and neither gets out first.

beats.speaker: hornet
beats.line: You fly like you're afraid of the ground.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: You fly like you're a crop-duster.

beats.speaker: hornet
beats.line: I was. We call it farming.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Hornets came in low, stung, climbed. Roughnecks held the roof. The enemy had nowhere to put a hand.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: You left something.

beats.speaker: hornet
beats.line: I always leave the nest. Come back for it.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: Fine. I'll eat what's left.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Two gunship wings worked the same valley from opposite ends and met in the middle with nothing standing between them.

beats.speaker: hornet
beats.line: That was a clean field.

beats.speaker: ceil
beats.line: You'd call it a pass. I'd call it a sweep.

beats.speaker: hornet
beats.line: We'll argue it in the mess.

talks.title: Flat things
talks.motif: low over flat ground, low over water

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Marsh complains that the war is flat. Gale points out that, at least, hers is wet.

beats.speaker: hornet
beats.line: Nothing to hide behind.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: Nothing to land on, except water.

beats.speaker: hornet
beats.line: That's the opposite problem, and it's yours.

talks.title: Second pass
talks.motif: low over flat ground, low over water

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Both wings took the same road: sting on the first pass, wait for the dust, return on the second.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: You come back.

beats.speaker: hornet
beats.line: I always come back. You do too.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: Have to. It's rude to leave a nest half-eaten.

talks.title: Rain on the field
talks.motif: low over flat ground, low over water

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: A storm flooded the flat ground Marsh hated. Her Hornets lifted off the fields while the Cutlasses settled on the new lake.

beats.speaker: hornet
beats.line: You made the war less flat.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: I made a pond. Come and see what it grows.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Volt's Jaguars have burned a line across the ridge. Marsh flies along it the way you'd follow a furrow.

beats.speaker: hornet
beats.line: Neat rows.

beats.speaker: volt
beats.line: That's a scouting report.

beats.speaker: hornet
beats.line: That's a plough line. Thank you.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Volt lights a column. Marsh dives on the burning end. Neither asked for the other's permission.

beats.speaker: volt
beats.line: You came in the moment I lit it.

beats.speaker: hornet
beats.line: You made it easy to find the corner of the field.

beats.speaker: volt
beats.line: I'm not used to being useful and fast.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Jaguars painted the target and the Hornets did the rest. The enemy regrouped around nothing.

beats.speaker: volt
beats.line: Sight, then wound.

beats.speaker: hornet
beats.line: Wound, then harvest.

beats.speaker: volt
beats.line: I'll take the trade.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Odessa has pegged a strip of cloth to the near bank. Charybdis hovers over it without noticing.

beats.speaker: odessa
beats.line: That's my ford.

beats.speaker: charybdis
beats.line: I thought it was a river.

beats.speaker: odessa
beats.line: It's a river with a tenant.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They cross at the same hour from opposite banks and meet in the middle, neither slowing.

beats.speaker: charybdis
beats.line: You came in under me.

beats.speaker: odessa
beats.line: You came in over me. Someone had to be the floor.

beats.speaker: charybdis
beats.line: Next crossing, I'll take the bank first.

beats.speaker: odessa
beats.line: You'll try.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The enemy had mined the shallows and watched the deep. The Telchines and the Charybdis came through the middle, a hand's width apart.

beats.speaker: odessa
beats.line: I'll admit it. It's a wide ford.

beats.speaker: charybdis
beats.line: It's your ford. I just rent the current.

beats.speaker: odessa
beats.line: Rent's overdue. Pay it in covering fire.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Anvil's Turtles leave a trench in the mud. Charybdis leaves a ripple that is gone by lunch.

beats.speaker: anvil
beats.line: I leave a mark.

beats.speaker: charybdis
beats.line: I leave room for the next tide.

beats.speaker: anvil
beats.line: That isn't an answer.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: A flooded road. Anvil sat in the middle of it, and the water stacked up behind him like a queue.

beats.speaker: charybdis
beats.line: You've dammed my road.

beats.speaker: anvil
beats.line: I've made a floor. You can use it.

beats.speaker: charybdis
beats.line: I'd rather go round.

beats.speaker: anvil
beats.line: There is no round. That's why I sat.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The advance stalled at a choke. Anvil held the mouth; Charybdis poured through the gap he left on purpose.

beats.speaker: charybdis
beats.line: You moved.

beats.speaker: anvil
beats.line: A hand's width. Don't tell anyone.

beats.speaker: charybdis
beats.line: The tide never tells. It just comes in.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Tarn's Salamanders come up the bank shaking off. Charybdis has not touched the water at all.

beats.speaker: tarn
beats.line: You skim.

beats.speaker: charybdis
beats.line: You dive. Same road.

beats.speaker: tarn
beats.line: Mine's colder.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They plotted the same crossing from opposite ends and arrived within a minute of each other.

beats.speaker: charybdis
beats.line: The map said walk round.

beats.speaker: tarn
beats.line: The map was written by people who like dry socks.

beats.speaker: charybdis
beats.line: I like the river better than the map.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Salamanders under, hovercraft over, one river holding both. The far line had faced the bridge.

beats.speaker: tarn
beats.line: They never looked at the water.

beats.speaker: charybdis
beats.line: Nobody does. It's why it works.

beats.speaker: tarn
beats.line: Then let's keep it a secret.

talks.title: Who goes first
talks.motif: a door that holds, a bait that leads

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Eight Grunts trot to the front of the line. Rusk watches them go with open disapproval.

beats.speaker: rusk
beats.line: You send them ahead.

beats.speaker: shiva
beats.line: They lead. I decide.

beats.speaker: rusk
beats.line: A door doesn't lead. A door stays.

talks.title: Fed to the line
talks.motif: a door that holds, a bait that leads

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Shiva's Grunts drew the enemy's count while Rusk's gate held the other side. Both sides called it a good day.

beats.speaker: rusk
beats.line: You spent your Grunts like coin.

beats.speaker: shiva
beats.line: I spent them where they were counted.

beats.speaker: rusk
beats.line: I spent six hours at a gate and one lie. I don't count.

talks.title: The count
talks.motif: a door that holds, a bait that leads

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Rusk's gate held; Shiva walked through the middle of it with her Grunts still at her heels.

beats.speaker: shiva
beats.line: You opened for me.

beats.speaker: rusk
beats.line: I opened for the count. You happened to be in it.

beats.speaker: shiva
beats.line: Next time, hold the door a second longer. I like the view.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Shiva and Cauter reach the same ridge from opposite sides, both certain they were first.

beats.speaker: cauter
beats.line: I was here.

beats.speaker: shiva
beats.line: I decided to be here.

beats.speaker: cauter
beats.line: Deciding is slow.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They closed on the same position, Grunts spreading, shotguns raised, and nobody agreed who gave the order.

beats.speaker: shiva
beats.line: You went early.

beats.speaker: cauter
beats.line: I went on time. You went on paper.

beats.speaker: shiva
beats.line: The paper won.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The line broke because two columns arrived from two sides, each sure it had been the second one.

beats.speaker: cauter
beats.line: That was mine.

beats.speaker: shiva
beats.line: That was ours. Put it in the minutes.

beats.speaker: cauter
beats.line: I don't take minutes. I take the ground.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Shiva's Grunts line up outside the Consul's workshop like a queue at a counter.

beats.speaker: shiva
beats.line: They need walls.

beats.speaker: consul
beats.line: They need forms first. I don't build for anonymous labour.

beats.speaker: shiva
beats.line: Then they'll sign.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: A small bastion went up behind the Grunts, built in an afternoon. Weiss kept the receipts.

beats.speaker: consul
beats.line: Every nano accounted for.

beats.speaker: shiva
beats.line: You build like someone paying a debt.

beats.speaker: consul
beats.line: Is it that obvious?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Grunts held the front. The Consul's wall held behind them. Neither had expected the other to arrive on time.

beats.speaker: shiva
beats.line: You've paid more than the contract asked.

beats.speaker: consul
beats.line: I'm not paying the contract.

beats.speaker: shiva
beats.line: I know. Keep going. We'll hold the door.

talks.title: Two tables
talks.motif: table of coordinates vs long arc

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Lund and Halq share a map. Each has drawn the other's firing line in a different colour.

beats.speaker: tremor
beats.line: Your grid is off by a street.

beats.speaker: halq
beats.line: Your spotter is off by a hill.

beats.speaker: tremor
beats.line: My spotter is never wrong. He's just slow.

talks.title: Same target
talks.motif: table of coordinates vs long arc

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Both batteries engaged the same position. The impact fell exactly between their two predictions.

beats.speaker: halq
beats.line: Mine was closer.

beats.speaker: tremor
beats.line: Mine was seen. Yours was guessed.

beats.speaker: halq
beats.line: Guessing is just seeing in advance.

talks.title: Firing table
talks.motif: table of coordinates vs long arc

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The enemy dug in behind a ridge neither could see over. They fired anyway, from either side.

beats.speaker: tremor
beats.line: Your arc got there first.

beats.speaker: halq
beats.line: Your Augur told it where to go. I'd call that a draw.

beats.speaker: tremor
beats.line: I'd call it dinner. You're buying.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Spoke's wheeled scouts roll past Lund's Rascals, who are walking.

beats.speaker: spoke
beats.line: Wheels. Not boots.

beats.speaker: tremor
beats.line: I like both, as long as they find it first.

beats.speaker: spoke
beats.line: I find it. You flatten it. We never need to meet.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: A scout returned with a ridge, a bunker, and a time. Lund fired without another word.

beats.speaker: tremor
beats.line: That was clean.

beats.speaker: spoke
beats.line: You only shell what you've been shown.

beats.speaker: tremor
beats.line: It's the only honest way to do it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Spoke's last wheel sat on a hill with the whole valley in it. The Tremor's shells followed his instructions.

beats.speaker: spoke
beats.line: You trust my wheels.

beats.speaker: tremor
beats.line: I trust what they show me. Today that's enough.

beats.speaker: spoke
beats.line: That's more than I give most people.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Lund writes her name in the dirt with every volley. Mira's barrage sparkles and her laughter carries across the camp.

beats.speaker: tremor
beats.line: Shells are a signature.

beats.speaker: mira
beats.line: They're fireworks!

beats.speaker: tremor
beats.line: They're a contract. You don't cheer at a contract.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The two batteries fired in the same hour. One was careful. One was a parade.

beats.speaker: mira
beats.line: Did you see mine?

beats.speaker: tremor
beats.line: I saw everything. That's the point.

beats.speaker: mira
beats.line: Then you saw it sparkle!

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The enemy's line was gone. Lund checked her count. Mira checked the sparkle.

beats.speaker: tremor
beats.line: Efficient.

beats.speaker: mira
beats.line: Beautiful.

beats.speaker: tremor
beats.line: Both can be true. I still sign mine.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Cole's generator stands at the edge of the pad. Hearth sits at the middle, steady and warm.

beats.speaker: stiletto
beats.line: I bring my own.

beats.speaker: hearth
beats.line: Then you won't need mine.

beats.speaker: stiletto
beats.line: I didn't say I wouldn't borrow.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: A brownout rolled across the grid. The Stilettos stayed fuelled. Hearth did not flicker.

beats.speaker: stiletto
beats.line: Your coal held.

beats.speaker: hearth
beats.line: Your bombers fly. Mine sits. We each do what we're built for.

beats.speaker: stiletto
beats.line: Mine eats energy. Yours gives it. Convenient.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The four Stilettos came back to the pad and found it warm. Hearth had kept the light on.

beats.speaker: stiletto
beats.line: You waited.

beats.speaker: hearth
beats.line: I never leave. It's not waiting.

beats.speaker: stiletto
beats.line: It felt like waiting. I'll take it.

talks.title: Static
talks.motif: EMP wing and a scout who sees by hurting

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Volt's Jaguars paint a target with lightning. Cole's bombers stop it with a pulse.

beats.speaker: volt
beats.line: I see it by hurting it.

beats.speaker: stiletto
beats.line: I see it by switching it off.

beats.speaker: volt
beats.line: We're the same.

talks.title: Both leave a mark
talks.motif: EMP wing and a scout who sees by hurting

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: A position with a burn scar and a silence where its guns used to be.

beats.speaker: volt
beats.line: Yours is quiet.

beats.speaker: stiletto
beats.line: Yours is loud. Between us they never knew where to look.

beats.speaker: volt
beats.line: Good.

talks.title: Painted and stopped
talks.motif: EMP wing and a scout who sees by hurting

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Volt lit the target. Cole stilled it. Then the Jaguars drove through the quiet.

beats.speaker: stiletto
beats.line: You light it, I stop it.

beats.speaker: volt
beats.line: You stop it, I make sure it remembers.

beats.speaker: stiletto
beats.line: Static and burn. We should make it a doctrine.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Stilettos pass overhead. Warder's beamers wait, cloaked, ready to dispute the airspace.

beats.speaker: stiletto
beats.line: Your guns are about to stop.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: They'll start again. I'll still be here.

beats.speaker: stiletto
beats.line: That's a very small kingdom.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The pulse went through. Every gun on the field stopped mid-sentence, Warder's included.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: You switched off my circle.

beats.speaker: stiletto
beats.line: I switched off everyone's. Yours just resumed first.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: I'd like it noted that I was unimpressed.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Stilettos cleared the air above the pad and the Warder's ring held the ground. The enemy found a locked door either way.

beats.speaker: stiletto
beats.line: Your circle held.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: Your sky was quiet. I'll allow it.

beats.speaker: stiletto
beats.line: From you, that's a medal.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Marlow and Wren come out of the creek laughing. Cinder Hook is already kneeling at the gate, planting something.

beats.speaker: marauder
beats.line: We were going to surprise them.

beats.speaker: commando
beats.line: I was going to surprise you first.

beats.speaker: marauder
beats.line: Is that a mine?

beats.speaker: commando
beats.line: It's a welcome mat.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Marauders arrived before the warning. Cinder Hook's Trappers had arrived before the Marauders.

beats.speaker: commando
beats.line: You're early.

beats.speaker: marauder
beats.line: You're underneath.

beats.speaker: commando
beats.line: Someone has to be. Mind the third step.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The raid went off like a joke with a long setup. Nobody on the enemy side got the punchline in time.

beats.speaker: marauder
beats.line: We don't apologise, you know. To anyone.

beats.speaker: commando
beats.line: Neither do I. I just leave notes in the dirt.

beats.speaker: marauder
beats.line: Leave one for us. We'll read it on the way out.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Twitcher is bolting something to the gate when the Marauders drip past him, still laughing.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: You're wet.

beats.speaker: marauder
beats.line: You're building. Both of us look guilty.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: I'm always building. Guilt is a separate project.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Twitcher has welded a tow hook to the Marauders' hull. They have not asked why, and they have not removed it.

beats.speaker: marauder
beats.line: It's a good hook.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: It's a good hook for a bad idea. Come see.

beats.speaker: marauder
beats.line: Is it wet?

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: It will be.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Twitcher laid a bridge over the ford at midnight. The Marauders took it at dawn, and the enemy took the river.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: I never said it would hold a crowd.

beats.speaker: marauder
beats.line: It held us. Everyone else was late.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: Best review I ever had.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Six Cutlasses sit on the bend. The Marauders come out of it from underneath.

beats.speaker: marauder
beats.line: Mind your floats. This is our river.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: Your river has my wing on it.

beats.speaker: marauder
beats.line: Then your wing is parked in our front garden.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: A flooded crossing, two ways through it, and no one willing to wait for the other.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: I land. You drive. Same crossing.

beats.speaker: marauder
beats.line: We got there first.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: You got there wet. I got there with a view.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Cutlasses held the sky over the bend while Marlow and Wren came up through the reeds. The defenders watched the wrong one.

beats.speaker: marauder
beats.line: Fine. It's half your river.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: Half is generous. I'll fly over the other half.

beats.speaker: marauder
beats.line: That's our half.

beats.speaker: gale
beats.line: Then I'll wave.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Halbard is polishing a heat ray the size of a cart. Ferrow looks at it the way a man looks at weather.

beats.speaker: lunkhead
beats.line: That's going to run hot.

beats.speaker: halbard
beats.line: It's a very good ray.

beats.speaker: lunkhead
beats.line: I'm sure. I'm still standing a hundred feet behind you when you fire it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Ferrow walks the Halberd around the camp, pointing at the places a door tends to get hit.

beats.speaker: lunkhead
beats.line: Rear plate. Left hinge. The bit nobody thinks about.

beats.speaker: halbard
beats.line: How do you know?

beats.speaker: lunkhead
beats.line: Every one of them has a story. I kept the receipts.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The ray sang across the field. The return fire found the Lunkhead, who had already moved into it.

beats.speaker: halbard
beats.line: You stepped in front of me.

beats.speaker: lunkhead
beats.line: I stepped where it was going to hurt anyway. Different thing.

beats.speaker: halbard
beats.line: I'll fire twice as slow. For you.

beats.speaker: lunkhead
beats.line: Twice as accurate will do.

talks.title: Same Dirt
talks.motif: the veteran and the shield counterpart

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Pavise is oiling her Centurion's plate. Ferrow parks his Lunkhead beside it without being asked.

beats.speaker: lunkhead
beats.line: You knew the commander before the suit changed.

beats.speaker: pavise
beats.line: I walked their left. You?

beats.speaker: lunkhead
beats.line: I just woke up in the company. It felt right.

talks.title: Two Old Walls
talks.motif: the veteran and the shield counterpart

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They hold the gate together, one with a ward and one with receipts.

beats.speaker: pavise
beats.line: You wait for it to hurt.

beats.speaker: lunkhead
beats.line: You wait for it to arrive. Both ways work.

beats.speaker: pavise
beats.line: Mine's quieter.

talks.title: Every Warrior
talks.motif: the veteran and the shield counterpart

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The ward still remembers every Warrior that stood in that dirt. Ferrow finally asks to hear the names.

beats.speaker: lunkhead
beats.line: I've kept the injuries. Never learned the names.

beats.speaker: pavise
beats.line: Then we trade. I'll give you the names.

beats.speaker: lunkhead
beats.line: And I'll tell you which of them it hurt.

talks.title: One Mind, One Wall
talks.motif: a veteran who has seen it all

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Vane's twelve Phobos peel off the line together. Ferrow watches them go without turning his head.

beats.speaker: lunkhead
beats.line: Pretty. Do they come back?

beats.speaker: vane
beats.line: When the beat returns.

beats.speaker: lunkhead
beats.line: Mine stays. That's the difference between us.

talks.title: Rhythm and Receipt
talks.motif: a veteran who has seen it all

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Vane counts the beat aloud. Ferrow counts something else under his breath.

beats.speaker: vane
beats.line: You're not keeping time.

beats.speaker: lunkhead
beats.line: I'm keeping score. It runs slower than a rhythm.

beats.speaker: vane
beats.line: It runs later. Mine runs first.

talks.title: The Hold
talks.motif: a veteran who has seen it all

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The beat broke under heavy laser fire. The pack scattered, and the only thing still standing was one grey plod.

beats.speaker: vane
beats.line: Your wall held when my rhythm didn't.

beats.speaker: lunkhead
beats.line: A wall is a very short thought. But it survives.

beats.speaker: vane
beats.line: Teach my flock one. Just one.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Reeve and Noctua both file flight paths for the same valley. The charts overlap like a bad argument.

beats.speaker: stronghold
beats.line: I bring my own sky.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: I dream mine. It's less crowded.

beats.speaker: stronghold
beats.line: Not for long.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Highwinds ran into the drone cloud over the ridge. Both groups broke and re-formed within ten seconds.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: You flew through my wing.

beats.speaker: stronghold
beats.line: I flew over it. The altitude was free.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: The altitude was filed.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Noctua's drones carpeted the radar while the Stronghold set down in the hole they left. No one dropped a single plane.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: I cleared you a lane.

beats.speaker: stronghold
beats.line: I'll keep to it. Next time I may even file.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: I'll believe it when I see it on paper.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Reeve hands Thresh a drop zone marked in red. Thresh looks at the sky above it and nothing else.

beats.speaker: stronghold
beats.line: My people land there.

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: My weather lands there too.

beats.speaker: stronghold
beats.line: Then move the weather.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Hailstorm cleared the zone with a minute to spare. The Stronghold needed ninety seconds.

beats.speaker: stronghold
beats.line: You were fast.

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: I'm always fast. I just don't look at what I hit.

beats.speaker: stronghold
beats.line: I do. Mine have to walk through it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: For once Thresh waited. The ship set down in the quiet where the bombs had been, and every passenger stepped out alive.

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: I looked. Just once.

beats.speaker: stronghold
beats.line: How was it?

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: Full of your people. I'll not do that again.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Vane's Phobos peel up the slope in one motion. Reeve watches them from the open ramp of the Stronghold.

beats.speaker: stronghold
beats.line: I could put you down where you're needed.

beats.speaker: vane
beats.line: I could be there before you land.

beats.speaker: stronghold
beats.line: Then we both win.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Highwinds, Banshees and Phobos moved across the field on one rhythm. Nobody had agreed to it.

beats.speaker: vane
beats.line: You keep time.

beats.speaker: stronghold
beats.line: I keep altitude. Close enough.

beats.speaker: vane
beats.line: Close enough is how a swarm begins.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Stronghold set down in the middle of the enemy line. The flock was already waiting there, as if it had always lived in that field.

beats.speaker: stronghold
beats.line: You beat me to my own landing.

beats.speaker: vane
beats.line: I heard you coming. It was the best note of the day.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Pip counts seven hovers. Tamsin counts twenty fleas and gives up at the number.

beats.speaker: possum
beats.line: That's a lot of Ticks.

beats.speaker: tick
beats.line: We prefer to say 'us'.

beats.speaker: possum
beats.line: Same thing. Cheaper, though.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Both packs lost a third of their number on the same sortie. Both laughed about it afterwards.

beats.speaker: tick
beats.line: We died cheap.

beats.speaker: possum
beats.line: We played dead cheap. It costs the same.

beats.speaker: tick
beats.line: We'll mint more.

beats.speaker: possum
beats.line: We'll stand up again.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The two swarms covered the fog together, hovers above and fleas below. The enemy radar stopped counting.

beats.speaker: tick
beats.line: We are the eyes.

beats.speaker: possum
beats.line: We are the eyes with rockets. Don't tell the singular ones.

beats.speaker: tick
beats.line: We never speak to the singular ones.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Spoke's Wheelie Bay rolls out sixteen scouts. Pip lets his Seekers hover quietly overhead.

beats.speaker: spoke
beats.line: Wheels don't float away.

beats.speaker: possum
beats.line: Floating doesn't get a tyre punctured.

beats.speaker: spoke
beats.line: Both of us are about to find out.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Wheelies and the Seekers reported on the same hill. They gave two different answers.

beats.speaker: spoke
beats.line: My scouts say it's empty.

beats.speaker: possum
beats.line: My Seekers say it isn't.

beats.speaker: spoke
beats.line: Then yours is the nervous kind.

beats.speaker: possum
beats.line: Mine was right last week.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: For one afternoon the Wheelies and the Seekers drew the same map. They did not mention it to each other.

beats.speaker: spoke
beats.line: Fine. You see well for something that floats.

beats.speaker: possum
beats.line: You see well for something on wheels.

beats.speaker: spoke
beats.line: Don't tell the bay.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Possums lie still in the grass. The Infestor seed stands in the same patch, and there are now six of them.

beats.speaker: possum
beats.line: You were five this morning.

beats.speaker: infestor
beats.line: The company grows itself.

beats.speaker: possum
beats.line: Mine plays dead. That's half the trick. Yours is just showing off.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Both packs waited in the same hollow for the enemy to pass. One pretended to be empty. The other was quietly adding to itself.

beats.speaker: infestor
beats.line: Patience is a garden.

beats.speaker: possum
beats.line: Patience is a bluff.

beats.speaker: infestor
beats.line: You'll want to move over. I'm planting.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Seven Possums stood up on cue. The hive had already put a dozen more behind them.

beats.speaker: possum
beats.line: I didn't ask for the help.

beats.speaker: infestor
beats.line: Nobody asks. They simply become the company.

beats.speaker: possum
beats.line: Then I'll grudgingly say thank you.

talks.title: Three is enough
talks.motif: the bomber that keeps coming back

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Kettle's Archangel logs every Phoenix it has dropped. Vell has asked to see the list.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: Three kills on you. I stopped there, out of courtesy.

beats.speaker: phoenix
beats.line: Courtesy is how you end up with a fourth.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: Then the courtesy is mine to regret.

talks.title: Cleared hot
talks.motif: the bomber that keeps coming back

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They shared a ceiling for one afternoon. Kettle held the flak, and Vell took the run.

beats.speaker: phoenix
beats.line: You had me in the reticle for the whole approach.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: Old habit. I kept thinking you were the other side.

beats.speaker: phoenix
beats.line: I am the other side. I'm just on loan.

talks.title: Same sky, other end
talks.motif: the bomber that keeps coming back

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: A Phoenix came home smoking. Kettle's Ferret walked her wing in to the pad.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: Fourth pass. I'd have bet against it.

beats.speaker: phoenix
beats.line: You'd have lost, and enjoyed it.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: Next time I shoot you, I'll aim to miss. Do not tell the others.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Nox asks Vell how many times she has been shot down. Vell asks Nox how long the sky has been owed.

beats.speaker: nox
beats.line: Weather. Since before the finale.

beats.speaker: phoenix
beats.line: Three crashes, one form filed. I think I'm ahead of you.

beats.speaker: nox
beats.line: Nobody is ahead of the sky.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Nox keeps a column in the ledger for her. It is headed Phoenix, returns.

beats.speaker: nox
beats.line: You are the only entry that pays back.

beats.speaker: phoenix
beats.line: Fire comes back. That's all it is.

beats.speaker: nox
beats.line: Then it is the one debt I like.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Nox held the anti-nuke ring while the Phoenixes came in low through its shadow.

beats.speaker: phoenix
beats.line: Nothing fell on us.

beats.speaker: nox
beats.line: That column is closed, then. Thank you for the paperwork.

beats.speaker: phoenix
beats.line: Open a new one. I'll be back.

talks.title: Two ways to burn
talks.motif: fire that returns and fire that walks

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Brakhov watches a Phoenix pair peel off a burning turret line and turn for home.

beats.speaker: brakhov
beats.line: You leave.

beats.speaker: phoenix
beats.line: I return. It's a different verb.

beats.speaker: brakhov
beats.line: I do not know that verb.

talks.title: The same char
talks.motif: fire that returns and fire that walks

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: She came back through the Kiln's smoke and landed with soot on her canopy that was not hers.

beats.speaker: phoenix
beats.line: You went in first and left me the good ash.

beats.speaker: brakhov
beats.line: I leave everything the good ash.

beats.speaker: phoenix
beats.line: Then I'll keep landing in it.

talks.title: Slow and fast
talks.motif: fire that returns and fire that walks

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Her bombs opened the gate, and Brakhov walked through before it stopped glowing.

beats.speaker: brakhov
beats.line: Eight hundred paces. You made it three hundred shorter.

beats.speaker: phoenix
beats.line: You never asked.

beats.speaker: brakhov
beats.line: I am asking now. Come back again.

talks.title: Wet surprise
talks.motif: out of the river, onto the mine

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Twitcher has buried something in the bank. Five Salamanders climb out of the river right beside it.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: You're standing on my best work.

beats.speaker: tarn
beats.line: You've built a landing mat for me. I'm touched.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: It goes off if you cough.

talks.title: Muddy shop
talks.motif: out of the river, onto the mine

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Tarn borrows the welder to patch a dented Salamander. It comes back with a trigger added.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: I made it shoot twice. You're welcome.

beats.speaker: tarn
beats.line: It already shot twice.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: Now it does it on purpose.

talks.title: The bank is ours
talks.motif: out of the river, onto the mine

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The enemy chased the Salamanders to the shore and found it already laid with Twitcher's gifts.

beats.speaker: tarn
beats.line: You knew where I'd come out.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: I always know where the river ends. I put the fun there.

beats.speaker: tarn
beats.line: Next time, tell me which half of the bank to avoid.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: A flooded canyon and a cliff stand between the company and the enemy. Tarn and Cinder Hook both grin.

beats.speaker: tarn
beats.line: That's a lake.

beats.speaker: commando
beats.line: That's a ledge.

beats.speaker: tarn
beats.line: Nobody ever agrees with us. This is lovely.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: She dropped on the cliff while his Salamanders came up through the pond below.

beats.speaker: commando
beats.line: You took the water.

beats.speaker: tarn
beats.line: You took the air. The middle is where everyone else is.

beats.speaker: commando
beats.line: I wouldn't go there.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They met inside the enemy base, from opposite sides, without having planned it.

beats.speaker: commando
beats.line: I thought you'd be late.

beats.speaker: tarn
beats.line: I thought you'd be dry.

beats.speaker: commando
beats.line: Neither of us was ever going to be. Good.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Scylla sits off the shore. The Warder's beamer ring sits on it. The shoreline belongs to both.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: That sand is inside my circle.

beats.speaker: scylla
beats.line: That sand is inside my range.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: Range is not ownership.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: A raiding party landed on the beach. The battleship shelled it, and a beamer finished what was left.

beats.speaker: scylla
beats.line: That was my kill.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: That was my dirt.

beats.speaker: scylla
beats.line: The shell made the crater. You only stood in it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Voss drew a line on the chart at the tide mark. Warder paced it out and left a stake at each end.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: Your water, my dirt. I will not apologise for the stakes.

beats.speaker: scylla
beats.line: I would not accept an apology. I'd consider it a retreat.

beats.speaker: warder
beats.line: Good. We understand each other, and I still do not like it.

talks.title: Heavy company
talks.motif: the biggest guns in the company

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The war room puts the Scylla and the Fatboy at the same end of the table. The table lists a little.

beats.speaker: fatboy
beats.line: You're a building that floats.

beats.speaker: scylla
beats.line: You're a ship that forgot the sea.

beats.speaker: fatboy
beats.line: I would have called that rude, but it is accurate.

talks.title: Two lanes of thunder
talks.motif: the biggest guns in the company

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: She hit the citadel from the bay while he came up the road. They fired within a heartbeat.

beats.speaker: scylla
