beats.line: Your shell landed after mine.

beats.speaker: fatboy
beats.line: Mine was heavier.

beats.speaker: scylla
beats.line: Then the citadel had a very bad quarter-hour.

talks.title: Neighbours
talks.motif: the biggest guns in the company

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Evening in camp. The ship rides the harbour, and the house sits on the quay above her.

beats.speaker: fatboy
beats.line: I could knock on you.

beats.speaker: scylla
beats.line: I could answer.

beats.speaker: fatboy
beats.line: Good. It would be a short conversation and a long echo.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Auditor wades down the slip and starts counting the Scylla's turrets. Voss lets it finish.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: Nine barrels. Sixty-one hundred rounds. Who pays?

beats.speaker: scylla
beats.line: The coast, when I'm done with it.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: I will note that as a promise.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: After the bombardment, the Auditor posts a tally on the pier. The figure is large.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: One hundred and four shells. The shore owes nothing, but I record it.

beats.speaker: scylla
beats.line: You record everything.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: Someone has to. You'd rather not know the number, Commander.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The tide went out and left the Scylla's keel two metres from the sea. The Auditor stood beside it, silent for once.

beats.speaker: scylla
beats.line: Go on. Count the days I can't sail.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: Four. I wrote five and corrected it.

beats.speaker: scylla
beats.line: I'll allow you the correction. I'll never allow the ledger.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Three Horizons skim a lake while Veil's jammer rolls a grey bank in behind them.

beats.speaker: tsunami
beats.line: You're hiding my scouts.

beats.speaker: veil
beats.line: Hiding is a service. Billing comes later.

beats.speaker: tsunami
beats.line: I'd pay for a haze that shows only me.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: She flew the bombers in behind the fog, with nothing on the enemy radar but a flicker.

beats.speaker: veil
beats.line: They saw static.

beats.speaker: tsunami
beats.line: They saw nothing, and then it was too late to look.

beats.speaker: veil
beats.line: A lovely invoice. I'll add it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Horizons found the target, Veil blinded the watchers, and the Tsunamis dropped through a grey gap.

beats.speaker: tsunami
beats.line: I've never been so sure of what I couldn't see.

beats.speaker: veil
beats.line: That is the whole business.

beats.speaker: tsunami
beats.line: Bill the company. I'll tell them we're worth it.

talks.title: Lanes and altitude
talks.motif: the seaplane wing leader and the night-flyer

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Noctua unrolls a map of flight paths, in colour, over the lake. Harrow squints at the lowest one.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: That is where your Horizons fly.

beats.speaker: tsunami
beats.line: That's where they have always flown. I keep them wet.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: Fly them higher and they'd see further.

talks.title: Landing practice
talks.motif: the seaplane wing leader and the night-flyer

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Harrow taught the drone-bay a seaplane landing. Noctua insisted on a swarm.

beats.speaker: tsunami
beats.line: One at a time. The water forgives gently.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: A hundred of them, and it forgives them all at once.

beats.speaker: tsunami
beats.line: Then I'll bring the lecture notes.

talks.title: Night run
talks.motif: the seaplane wing leader and the night-flyer

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Tsunami wing flew a night strike through Noctua's drone corridor. It was the first time they all came home dry.

beats.speaker: tsunami
beats.line: You flew a road in the dark, and gave the credit to me.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: You taught me that the water will always catch you.

beats.speaker: tsunami
beats.line: I only said it. You made it true.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Four Tsunamis cross the shoreline at ten metres. Kettle's Archangel swings to follow.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: You are in my ceiling.

beats.speaker: tsunami
beats.line: I am under it. There is a difference.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: Not to my flak.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Archangel fired a salvo at an unmarked wing and got within a hair of the Tsunamis.

beats.speaker: tsunami
beats.line: You nearly had us.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: You flew in without a call sign.

beats.speaker: tsunami
beats.line: I flew in with a plan. You'd have heard it if you asked.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They split the lake in two on the map. High for the saint, low for the seaplanes.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: Your sky is below the line.

beats.speaker: tsunami
beats.line: Yours is above it. If anyone crosses, we'll both fire.

beats.speaker: kettle
beats.line: That is the first thing you have said that I agree with.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Mask wears a commander's plate. Rumor wears whoever she last turned. They size each other up across the mess table.

beats.speaker: mask
beats.line: I'm sure I've seen you somewhere.

beats.speaker: rumor
beats.line: Everyone has. It was never me.

beats.speaker: mask
beats.line: Funny. I say the same about myself.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Rumor turned an enemy picket in the morning. Mask's Pawns saluted it in the afternoon.

beats.speaker: rumor
beats.line: I get paid for the pretending.

beats.speaker: mask
beats.line: I do it for the pawns. They'd salute a fence post.

beats.speaker: rumor
beats.line: You are better at the job. You just don't know you have one.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: A cloaked Ghost walked up to Mask in the dark and hesitated. For once Rumor had nothing to say.

beats.speaker: rumor
beats.line: I can turn anyone. Not you.

beats.speaker: mask
beats.line: Why not me?

beats.speaker: rumor
beats.line: You already switched sides. The Pawns just haven't noticed yet.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Consul unrolls a plan for a fort. Tarquin is already pacing it out in the dirt.

beats.speaker: consul
beats.line: There's a form for this.

beats.speaker: mason
beats.line: There's a fort for this. Yours can follow.

beats.speaker: consul
beats.line: Mine usually does. Eventually.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They fortified opposite slopes of the same hill and met at the top, one wall short.

beats.speaker: mason
beats.line: Your corner is off by a stride.

beats.speaker: consul
beats.line: Your corner is off by a regulation.

beats.speaker: mason
beats.line: Then we split the stride and burn the regulation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The wall held through the whole night. Each of them has told the story with the other one in it.

beats.speaker: consul
beats.line: I filed it under both of us.

beats.speaker: mason
beats.line: I carved it under both of us. Stone outlasts paper.

beats.speaker: consul
beats.line: Paper gets copied. We'll see.

talks.title: Hinges
talks.motif: the door and the wall around it

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Rusk inspects Tarquin's new gate the way other men inspect horses.

beats.speaker: rusk
beats.line: Good hinge.

beats.speaker: mason
beats.line: Good door. It had better be, with you standing in it.

beats.speaker: rusk
beats.line: I always stand in it.

talks.title: Built to be held
talks.motif: the door and the wall around it

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: She built the gate a hand narrower than the plan, so one man could hold it.

beats.speaker: rusk
beats.line: You built it for me.

beats.speaker: mason
beats.line: I built it for whoever stands there. It's usually you.

talks.title: The six-hour gate
talks.motif: the door and the wall around it

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Rusk held her gate for six hours. Not a stone moved.

beats.speaker: rusk
beats.line: Your wall didn't give.

beats.speaker: mason
beats.line: Your door didn't either. Legion work, both of us.

beats.speaker: rusk
beats.line: Legion work.

talks.title: Under the floor
talks.motif: straight lines and surprises in the dirt

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Tarquin finds a mine under the foundation she has just poured. Twitcher is whistling nearby.

beats.speaker: mason
beats.line: This was not in the plan.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: That's what makes it work.

beats.speaker: mason
beats.line: That is what makes it explode.

talks.title: Shared ground
talks.motif: straight lines and surprises in the dirt

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: They agreed on a line in the dirt. Her side gets walls; his side gets whatever he finds funny.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: Your side's very tidy.

beats.speaker: mason
beats.line: Yours is very loud.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: Both kept the enemy out.

talks.title: The fort that bit
talks.motif: straight lines and surprises in the dirt

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The enemy breached her wall and walked straight into his field. Nobody came through a second time.

beats.speaker: mason
beats.line: I still do not approve.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: But you left me the gap.

beats.speaker: mason
beats.line: I left you the gap.

talks.title: Holding pattern
talks.motif: two who build in the air

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Noctua's fighters and Atterby's Falcons share a sky for the first time. Nobody collides, which surprises both of them.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: You fly them like they're coming home.

beats.speaker: rookery
beats.line: They are. I build the home first, then I teach them where it is.

beats.speaker: noctua
beats.line: I dream the routes. You pour the runway at the end of them. That's a good night's work.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Atterby drops solar collectors on a ridge nobody can reach. Solarium is already working out the yield.

beats.speaker: solarium
beats.line: South-facing, no shade, nobody to steal the cables. You picked that for the light.

beats.speaker: rookery
beats.line: I picked it because it's hard to get to. The light was a bonus.

beats.speaker: solarium
beats.line: Then we want the same ground for different reasons. That's the best kind of partnership.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Tarquin paces out a fort on the flat. Atterby is building one on the crag above it.

beats.speaker: mason
beats.line: You can't wall a cliff.

beats.speaker: rookery
beats.line: I don't have to. The cliff is the wall.

beats.speaker: mason
beats.line: And when they bring aircraft?

beats.speaker: rookery
beats.line: Then they'll meet mine first. Yours will hear about it later.

talks.title: Weather report
talks.motif: nests and the weather that comes from above

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Thresh's Hailstorm passes over Atterby's shelf base on the way out. The Falcons scramble before anyone has said a word.

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: Easy. I'm on your side this week.

beats.speaker: rookery
beats.line: My birds don't read the contract. They read the bomb bay.

beats.speaker: thresh
beats.line: Then keep them on a short leash. Weather doesn't apologise.

talks.title: The far bank
talks.motif: fords are doors, and somebody has to build the frame

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Odessa holds a ford. On the far bank, four Beavers are already laying a metal extractor.

beats.speaker: odessa
beats.line: I take the crossing, you take the bank?

beats.speaker: dam
beats.line: We take the bank, the bed, and the next bank. You keep the door shut while we pour.

beats.speaker: odessa
beats.line: Deal. Don't build a lock on my door.

beats.speaker: dam
beats.line: Only a small one.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Weiss arrives with a survey of the river. Brisk is standing in it.

beats.speaker: consul
beats.line: I need to log where you're building.

beats.speaker: dam
beats.line: Under the water, mostly. You're welcome to come and measure.

beats.speaker: consul
beats.line: There is a form for submerged works.

beats.speaker: dam
beats.line: Then it'll be the first form that gets wet.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Tarn's Salamanders come up through the shallows straight into Brisk's half-built dam.

beats.speaker: tarn
beats.line: You've blocked my road.

beats.speaker: dam
beats.line: I've built on your road. There's a difference, and it's the difference between us.

beats.speaker: tarn
beats.line: Rivers move, Brisk.

beats.speaker: dam
beats.line: Not once we're done with them.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The company's two newest builders compare notes over a map with water at the bottom and cliffs at the top.

beats.speaker: rookery
beats.line: You take everything below the waterline.

beats.speaker: dam
beats.line: You take everything above the treeline.

beats.speaker: rookery
beats.line: And the middle?

beats.speaker: dam
beats.line: The middle is where everyone else fights. We just hand them the ground.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Volt's spotters light up a position. Vasse's Welders are already walking into it.

beats.speaker: volt
beats.line: I marked that for the artillery.

beats.speaker: arc
beats.line: Artillery's slow. I'm here.

beats.speaker: volt
beats.line: Sight is a wound you give them. You just make it bigger.

beats.speaker: arc
beats.line: Bigger is the point.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Sallow is patching a lab with his welder, badly. Vasse watches for a whole minute before he speaks.

beats.speaker: arc
beats.line: You're running the bead too hot.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: Hot's how I like it.

beats.speaker: arc
beats.line: Hot's how it fails. Slow your hand. Let the metal ask.

beats.speaker: twitch
beats.line: Huh. It holds. Don't tell anyone you were nice to me.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Anvil & Mire hold the line. Eight Welders pass through it and set the far side on fire.

beats.speaker: anvil
beats.line: You walk through my wall.

beats.speaker: arc
beats.line: I walk out of your wall. You're the anvil; I'm what hits the other thing.

beats.speaker: anvil
beats.line: Then hit it hard. I'll still be here.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Cauter's riot and Vasse's Welders reach the same breach from opposite ends.

beats.speaker: cauter
beats.line: This is my sentence. You're interrupting it.

beats.speaker: arc
beats.line: I don't write sentences. I join things and unjoin things.

beats.speaker: cauter
beats.line: Then unjoin yourself from my breach.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Varn is pacing the line, hungry for the push. Brandt has not moved the Mammoth all hour.

beats.speaker: halbard
beats.line: We should go. Now.

beats.speaker: mammoth
beats.line: Sit down, dear. They're coming to us. They always do.

beats.speaker: halbard
beats.line: And if they don't?

beats.speaker: mammoth
beats.line: Then you'll have had a nice rest, and you can go hungry later.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Bro parks next to the Mammoth and says nothing for a while. Brandt seems to like that.

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: Yeah. Good spot.

beats.speaker: mammoth
beats.line: It's the only spot. Have you eaten?

beats.speaker: bro
beats.line: Yeah.

beats.speaker: mammoth
beats.line: Have some more anyway.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Kiln walks past the Mammoth toward the turrets. Brandt does not follow.

beats.speaker: brakhov
beats.line: Forward.

beats.speaker: mammoth
beats.line: Forward is where the turrets are, Brakhov. They'll still be there tomorrow.

beats.speaker: brakhov
beats.line: So will I.

beats.speaker: mammoth
beats.line: That's what you said last time, and I had to come and fetch you.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Stride's Gunslingers tear past the Mammoth's feet, kicking ash over its armour.

beats.speaker: mammoth
beats.line: Young man. Slow down and say good evening.

beats.speaker: stride
beats.line: Good evening, ma'am. Bye now.

beats.speaker: mammoth
beats.line: I'll remember that, and so will the Mammoth.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Ferro's Gladiators salute an enemy line. Kit Sparkler lights the sky behind them on cue.

beats.speaker: gladius
beats.line: Perfect timing.

beats.speaker: kit
beats.line: I always light up when someone bows.

beats.speaker: gladius
beats.line: Then we'll do the whole tour. Every field an arena, every arena a finale.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Stride overtakes the Gladiators mid-feint and steals the kill.

beats.speaker: gladius
beats.line: That was my bow.

beats.speaker: stride
beats.line: That was my target. Bowing's slow.

beats.speaker: gladius
beats.line: Bowing's how the crowd knows who won. Nobody saw you, Stride.

beats.speaker: stride
beats.line: Exactly.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Auditor reviews the ammunition Ferro's troupe spent on flourishes.

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: Thirty percent of your shots were theatre.

beats.speaker: gladius
beats.line: And a hundred percent of the enemy watched it. What's that worth?

beats.speaker: auditor
beats.line: Nothing I can enter in a column.

beats.speaker: gladius
beats.line: Then your columns are missing the best part.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Marlow and Wren come out of the river laughing, straight into the middle of Ferro's salute.

beats.speaker: marauder
beats.line: Are you bowing at us?

beats.speaker: gladius
beats.line: At whoever makes the best entrance. Tonight, that's you.

beats.speaker: marauder
beats.line: We'll take it. Wren's never been applauded.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Halq calls a grid square. Calder answers with the hour the water turns over it.

beats.speaker: halq
beats.line: Four-seven, four-nine.

beats.speaker: triton
beats.line: Dry for forty minutes after the second bell.

beats.speaker: halq
beats.line: Then that's when we shoot.

beats.speaker: triton
beats.line: And that's when I'm already there.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Calder's Tritons hold a perfect line along the shore. The Charybdis comes in wide and floods through it.

beats.speaker: triton
beats.line: You broke my line.

beats.speaker: charybdis
beats.line: I don't believe in lines. Or sides.

beats.speaker: triton
beats.line: The Legion does. I'll be here when you need one to retreat behind.

beats.speaker: charybdis
beats.line: I never retreat. I recede.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: The Scylla walks out of the sea onto Calder's beach.

beats.speaker: scylla
beats.line: You've kept the shore clear.

beats.speaker: triton
beats.line: For you. The channel is wide enough as far as the second sandbar.

beats.speaker: scylla
beats.line: Then I'll stop at the second sandbar.

beats.speaker: triton
beats.line: You won't. But I'll be there when you get stuck.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Tarn's Salamanders surface just behind Calder's line.

beats.speaker: tarn
beats.line: Your line faces the wrong way.

beats.speaker: triton
beats.line: My line faces the sea. You came from the river. I'll correct for it next time.

beats.speaker: tarn
beats.line: There won't be a next time.

beats.speaker: triton
beats.line: There's always a next tide.

talks.title: Breakwater
talks.motif: the works and the line that guards them

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Brisk's Beavers build on the shoal while Calder's Tritons sit in a line in front of them.

beats.speaker: dam
beats.line: You make a good breakwater.

beats.speaker: triton
beats.line: You make a good reason to be one.

beats.speaker: dam
beats.line: Hold till the tide turns and the base is up.

beats.speaker: triton
beats.line: I always know when the tide turns.
